review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only case. Repository identity and base commit, REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, evidence stages, and exact writable binding scopes agree with the original PRD. The complete implementation evidence supports a derived read-only getter without duplicate state; the acceptance criteria correctly preserve completed/error event timing, deferred pending updates, clear semantics, and final-zero checks after onIdle. The bounded test owners and existing runtime/build/type-check entry points are appropriate. Build configuration establishes generated dist declarations rather than a separately maintained declaration owner. TASK-IMPLEMENT and independent TASK-VERIFY, with verification dependent on implementation and both covering every required AC, match the specification. Their allowed agents have the relevant supplied active trusted capability claims, roles, project memberships, and availability; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. A separate active project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case's frozen inputs, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the documented normalization and distinct source-manifest/evaluation digest domains explain their differing values. Model, policy, sampling, and budget fingerprints are consistently frozen. The supplied isolation evidence distinguishes retained historical operations from candidates on this bundle and does not use historical outputs to set expectations. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and evidence, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, or a new human attestation.
